Good morning, dragon riders! Welcome to Dragon School. Today we have three dragons here. The red dragon is called Storm. Storm can fly very fast and he can breathe fire, but he can't swim. The blue dragon is called River. River can swim, but she can't breathe fire. And the little green dragon is called Pip. Pip can't fly yet. He is only two years old. Be brave today. Every rider starts small.

My name is Max and I am a dragon rider. Every morning I go to the cave. Storm sleeps in the cave, on the cold rocks. When he wakes up, he opens his big wings and he looks at me. I climb on his back and I hold on. Storm can jump very high. Then we fly over the mountain. I am not afraid. I am brave now, but on my first day I was very afraid.
